description: Search Czech operating-lease offers ("operativní leasing") from lessors, brokers and dealers: a concrete car with a monthly payment for a contract length and yearly mileage. Each offer carries its price with and without 21 % VAT, the provider, what the payment includes and, where enough comparable offers exist, how far it is below or above the median for the same model, engine, term and mileage. Without term/km each offer shows its price nearest to 36 months / 10 000 km.

audience.description: private (default): offers open to consumers, priceMin/priceMax with VAT. business: companies and sole traders, price limits without VAT

bodyTypes.description: sedan | suv | hatchback | combi | cabrio | van | coupe

fuels.description: petrol | diesel | electric | hybrid | lpg | cng

sort.description: recommended (default: furthest below median first) | price_asc | price_desc | newest
